newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Citra Marga sees 1997 net at 154 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Citra Marga sees 1997 net at 154 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian toll-road builder and operator PT Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada said on Tuesday that it expected to post a net profit of 154 billion rupiah in 1997.
Company finance director Tito Sulistio told reporters after a general meeting of shareholders that the forecast had been raised from a previous projection of 145 billion rupiah in January.
The company posted net profit of 123.6 billion rupiah in 1996.
